name: Civic Story
source:
Our World is In Danger. We need politicians to make decisions... But nobody votes!

In Civic Story, Players play as a citizen thrust into a sudden federal election season. Throughout its interactive 8-Chapter Story, Players will experience how the election climate, charismatic politicians, and various politics affect them and others through its comedic story full of colourful and quirky characters.

When a sudden election rocks the country, whose side are you on?

[from [url=https://shiningspark.itch.io/civicstory]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们的世界正处于危险之中。我们需要政客做出决定……但没有人投票！

在《公民故事》中，玩家扮演一名公民，被推入突如其来的联邦选举季节。在互动的8章故事中，玩家将通过充满丰富多彩和古怪角色的喜剧故事体验选举气氛、魅力政治家和各种政治如何影响他们和其他人。

当一场突如其来的大选震撼全国时，你站在哪一边？

[来自[url=https://shiningspark.itch.io/civicstory]itch.io[/url]]
